conditional_within_tx100_uncertainty.scope_label: Conditional on these 87 revealed TX100 rows; row bootstrap treats rows as exchangeable and is not a population-level or cross-chemistry interval.

exploratory_chemistry_group_calibration_.guarantee: None. TX100 labels were already revealed; six group maxima are too few for a useful 90% group-level finite-sample conformal quantile.
exploratory_chemistry_group_calibration_.method: Leave one development CMC group out, fit the locked XGBoost declaration on all other groups, and use the maximum absolute residual in the held-out group as a radius.

interpretation_boundaries: All confidence intervals are conditional within the observed TX100 rows.
The row bootstrap does not account for broader chemistry or laboratory sampling.
The group-max calibration sensitivity was designed after label reveal and has no nominal guarantee.
BH correction covers only the four locked matched-budget applicability tests.
Target selections come unchanged from the frozen pre-reveal ranking artifact.

multiple_testing.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg applied to scientifically corrected p-values
multiple_testing.degenerate_null_policy: A zero- or full-retention budget has one possible subset and p=1.0. The frozen strict-minmax p=0.444155... is retained only as an audited floating-point/permutation artifact.
multiple_testing.direction: probability random retained risk is no larger than observed
multiple_testing.family: four locked applicability matched-budget random-retention tests

strict_minmax.p_value_correction_reason: degenerate null: only one subset exists at this budget

read_only_audit.output_policy: exclusive creation in a separate caller-selected directory

recovery_audit_from_result.only_behavioral_change: convert undefined NaN query fields to JSON null
recovery_audit_from_result.reason: Strict JSON serialization rejected NaN fields generated for unanswered target-search queries after all locked metrics had been computed.

target_search_comparison.outcome_definition: actual selected diameter within 10% of fixed target

tie_aware_risk_coverage.aurc_definition: right-step integral over coverage from zero to one
tie_aware_risk_coverage.tie_rule: all exactly tied rows enter atomically
